title: TaskReadFirst af/TaskReadFirst@1
$comment: What a Task's Worker is told to read before its goal (ADR-0198): the project's standing rules, `.af/rules.md` of the Authority Snapshot, and the files the Task file's `context` names, each bound by the digest of the bytes the Task captured. Referenced from TaskRevisionV1.provenance.input_artifact_ids, written only when there is something to read, and listed at the end of the Task's requirements text, so a changed file is a changed plan.

reference.description: What the Task file wrote: a repository path, optionally with a `#section` anchor.

path.description: The repository path the reference names, a prefix of it.
